why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for A.J. Ewing is slot #3 (4.657 expected team runs/game).
Slots #3, #5, #4, #6, #2, #8, #7, #9, #1 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #1 ranks 9 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.003 R/G.
Slot #3 yields 4.47 expected PA/game vs 4.69 at primary slot #1. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
Offensive profile group: Power (exploratory unsupervised cluster — not a definitive archetype).
